text: Carrying the shingle stack: the held bundle model fills the lower-right third of the view and hides the last open roof section when looking straight up (pitch ~83). Had to sweep yaw blind until the label read 'Hole in the roof'. Tick ~20500.

Looking with arrow keys at 2-4 fps is unreliable: hold Down 2.0 moved pitch 83->16 one time and 16->-12 the next; hold Down 0.25 sometimes changed nothing and sometimes 23 degrees. Aim keeps settling after state is read, so E landed on 'Your wagon' instead of the shingles (status 'Aim at what you want from the wagon, then E.').
